item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 08/Dec/2021
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will continue to affect southern China in the next few days. The weather will be generally fine over the region. A replenishment of the northeast monsoon is expected to bring cool weather to the coastal areas of southern China early next week.

Date/Month: 09/12 (Thursday)
Wind: East to northeast force 4, force 5 at first.
Weather: Fine. Dry during the day.
Temp range: 18 - 23 C
R.H. range: 55 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 10/12 (Friday)

Weather: Mainly fine. Dry during the day.
Temp range: 18 - 23 C
